note: Clear Creek RD, Arapaho-Roosevelt NF, ~10,000 ft on paved Guanella Pass Rd 4 mi S of Georgetown; reservoir ~1.5 mi away. --Claude
summary: FS page, ARP status table and recreation.gov: confirmed 8 first-come Scan & Pay sites, vault toilets, no water, $23 (2026; 2027 $23). Added max_rig_ft 25 (FS page: spurs 15-25 ft), operating season May 29 - Sept 20, booking note. Pin sits ~60 m west of the small loop seen on imagery beside Guanella Pass Rd (RIDB has no per-site coordinates); OK. Not waterfront confirmed: the loop is west of the road, South Clear Creek is beyond it, and the Xcel Cabin Creek reservoirs above the plant are behind dams. Site shows 'Site Closed' for the season only. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: CRITERIA (rig length): the agency singles this campground out - 'all are suitable for small camper trailers and tents' (FS page and recreation.gov) - and its own figures disagree: the FS page and recreation.gov say 'The parking length ranges from 15 to 25 feet', but the ARP Clear Creek RD Campground Status table gives Max Spur 15'. Recorded 25 (the stated range); neither source says how many of the 8 spurs reach 23 ft, and RIDB's catalog carries no per-site lengths. If the status table's 15 ft is right, EKKO fits none.
